name: guardhouse
description: Connect Codex to your Guardhouse instance, audit applications, configure sign-in branding and custom HTML/CSS, and edit or test transactional email templates.

interface.longDescription: The official Guardhouse plugin by LegioSoft. Connect a local Codex host to your Guardhouse server through native MCP OAuth. Inspect and audit existing applications, integrate local projects, and configure supported browser settings. Update sign-in colors, typography, layout and content, or edit complete custom HTML/CSS for a shared layout, page or state. Read saved and default email templates, edit subjects and HTML, enable or disable custom overrides, and send a requested test to the signed-in administrator. Available operations follow the server's live capabilities. This beta requires an administrator-enabled integration and registered stable OAuth callback; asset uploads and removals use the Guardhouse admin UI.
capabilities: Native OAuth connection to your Guardhouse instance
Application discovery, security audits and local project integration
Sign-in colors, typography, layout and content
Complete branding HTML/CSS reads and scoped source edits
Email subjects, HTML, placeholders and custom-override status
Requested test emails to the signed-in administrator
defaultPrompt: Help me get started with Guardhouse.
Review and update my Guardhouse sign-in branding.
Review my Guardhouse email templates and custom HTML.

publication.release_notes: 0.3.0 beta candidate: adds email-template discovery, complete saved/default HTML reads, placeholder guidance, subject/HTML editing, custom-override status and requested administrator test emails. Adds complete branding HTML/CSS reads with defaults and scoped layout/page/state edits. Disabling an email override restores built-in delivery; editing inactive content does not activate it. Writes use fresh revisions, preserve unrelated settings and reuse existing user authorization.
